title: Whichever is ready
hints: Receiving from a, then b, then a… blocks on a even when only b has a message. select waits on several channels at once and takes whichever is ready.
Loop n times. In each iteration, one select with a case for a and a case for b appends the message it receives.
for range n { select { case m := <-a: out = append(out, m); case m := <-b: out = append(out, m) } }
